notes.title: Development Update: Demo Release Postponement and Future Plans
notes.notes:
Dear Players,

The Bearstone Campsite development team is excited to announce a strategic step toward delivering the best possible gaming experience. While we are planning to launch the full version in Q4 2025, we have decided to postpone our demo release to Next Fest in June 2025.

Why the Postponement?
Our primary goal in making this decision is to maximize the initial impact of the demo while ensuring that the full version meets your high expectations in terms of hardware, features, and quality. The meticulous improvements we are implementing during development are crucial to providing you with a richer and smoother experience.

Our Strategic Approach
This postponement is a carefully considered move that goes beyond short-term challenges and aligns with our long-term vision for quality and sustainable success. Our commitment to continuous improvement drives us to address every detail with the utmost care.

Thank you for your understanding and ongoing support. We will continue to keep you updated on all future developments.

Enjoy,
Holy Marmot
Bearstone Campsite Development Team

notes.title: WELCOME TO BEARSTONE CAMPSITE
notes.notes:
[h2]Bearstone Campsite: Lost Truths in the Heart of the Forest[/h2]    
        Originally established by the government as a tourism destination, [u]Bearstone Campsite[/u] was closed shortly after a mysterious incident.         Today, this abandoned facility has evolved into a realm that conceals unforeseen dangers and long-forgotten secrets, far beyond its former splendor.    
   
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45291255/94bd173f075332bbf1a2f5e722339ee17fed367e.png[/img] 

[h2]Lost Friends, Hidden Secrets[/h2]    
        This site now stands as a desolate domain. To locate your loved ones and uncover what truly transpired, you must diligently search every corner         for clues left behind by silent witnesses of the past. Unraveling the mystery of the camp’s abrupt closure is not merely about rescuing your friends—        it is also an endeavor to reveal the dark narrative hidden beneath.    
    
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45291255/00a15144e6082443829d3edc09799c0af7c42fec.png[/img]

[h2]The Manbear Legend and Stealth in the Shadows[/h2]    
        Deep within the confines of the camp, the legend of [u]Manbear[/u] hints at both terror and the will to survive.         As you delve into this lore, you will need to proceed with utmost caution, moving quietly in the shadows to evade the dangerous [u]“crawlers”[/u]         that roam under cover of darkness. Each step requires vigilance, as every dim corridor and secluded passage may harbor an unexpected threat.    
    
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45291255/b52ccb89e4b6d217c524991d2e5bfa548ff433fd.png[/img]

[h2]A Struggle for Survival and the Pursuit of Truth[/h2]    
        [u]Bearstone Campsite[/u] is not simply a mystery to be solved; it is a formidable test of endurance and survival.         In your quest to uncover the truth behind its enigmatic closure, you will embark on a journey that demands strategic planning and valor.         Every step brings you closer to your missing friends and further exposes the somber realities of the past.    
    
        Now arriving on [u]Steam[/u], [u]Bearstone Campsite[/u] invites you to experience its dark and enigmatic atmosphere.         Seek out your lost friends, follow the trail of the [u]Manbear[/u] legend, and unearth the dreadful truth concealed within this forsaken establishment.    
    
        Bearstone Campsite – Will you reunite your friends and secure your survival?
